data.one_liner: Provides access to Unicode 17.0 emojis, including metadata, skin tone variants, and search.
data.what_it_does: The package exposes a collection of Emoji objects and a UnicodeEmojis class that lets you retrieve all emojis or search by name, short name, category, subcategory, or ASCII representation. It also supports skin tone variations for human emojis.
use_when: You need a comprehensive list of emojis with metadata for a Flutter or Dart app.
You want to search emojis by various attributes without pulling data from an API.
You need skin tone variants for human emojis in your UI.
avoid_when: You only need a few specific emojis and want to avoid the overhead of a large data set.
You require real-time emoji updates from a server rather than static data.
strengths: Fast search algorithm with optional result limit.
Built-in support for skin tone variations.
weaknesses: Large package size due to full emoji data.
No UI widgets; only data access.
No support for custom emoji images or animations.
